facts.text: I am in the process of moving into my new home.
I purchased a 3-bedroom colonial-style home for $400,000.
I fell in love with the home during an open house on February 10th.
The home had a listing price of $425,000 when I first saw it.
I am interested in determining the right home insurance coverage limit for my home.
I want to understand the difference between actual cash value (ACV) and replacement cost value (RCV) in home insurance.
I want to know how ACV versus RCV affects my insurance premium.
I am thinking of getting a home inventory done to keep track of my belongings.
I recently purchased a 3-bedroom colonial-style home.
I want to make sure I have a thorough record of my belongings.
I feel overwhelmed with all the boxes and clutter from the move.
